        existing_annotation_strategy=ExistingAnnotationStrategy.REPLICATE,

    module_stub_without_existing = stub_without_existing.get(module, None)
    
    if module_stub_with_existing is None or module_stub_without_existing is None:
        return None
        
    stub_with_existing_str = module_stub_with_existing.render()
    stub_without_existing_str = module_stub_without_existing.render()
    
    # Generate unified diff
    lines_with_existing = stub_with_existing_str.splitlines(keepends=True)
    lines_without_existing = stub_without_existing_str.splitlines(keepends=True)
    
    diff = difflib.unified_diff(
        lines_without_existing,
        lines_with_existing,
        fromfile="without existing annotations",
        tofile="with existing annotations",
        lineterm=""
    )
    
    return "".join(diff)
